blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine women’s national basketball team will chart its own path under a new identity after Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas and University Athletic Association of the Philippines unveiled Gilas Hiraya on Saturday. Derived from the Filipino word for the fruit of one’s dreams, hopes and aspirations, Hiraya reflects the women’s team’s ambition to build its own legacy and establish a distinct identity in Philippine basketball.
